name: navidrome
description: Personal music streaming server with a modern browser interface and Subsonic-compatible apps

fields.name: WEB_PORT
fields.label: R1: Web Interface Port
fields.help: Host port used to open Navidrome in bridge mode. In Host Mode, Navidrome listens directly on NAS port 4533.

fields.name: DATA_LOCATION
fields.label: R2: Data Folder
fields.help: Writable host folder for Navidrome's database, cache, settings, artwork, and application state. EasyDocker creates this folder when needed.

fields.name: MUSIC_LOCATION
fields.label: R3: Music Folder
fields.help:
Existing NAS folder containing your music library. Replace the example with the real host path.
The folder is mounted read-only, so Navidrome can scan and stream music without modifying the original files.

fields.name: NAVIDROME_NETWORK_MODE
fields.label: O1: Network
fields.help: Choose Create New Bridge for the recommended default, Host Mode, or an existing named Docker network. Bridge mode is normally sufficient for browsers and Subsonic-compatible music apps.

fields.name: RESTART_POLICY
fields.label: O2: Restart Policy
fields.help: Controls whether the container restarts automatically.

fields.name: NAVIDROME_IMAGE
fields.label: A1: Image
fields.help: Official Navidrome container image. Change this only if you need a pinned version or another image source.

fields.name: NAVIDROME_RUNTIME_USER
fields.label: A2: Runtime User (UID:GID)
fields.help:
Leave blank for the recommended EasyDocker default so automatically created folders work without a UID/GID ownership mismatch.
Advanced users may enter a value such as 1000:10 after confirming that this user and group can write to the data folder and read the music folder. Setting the wrong IDs causes Database could not be opened errors.

fields.name: NAVIDROME_PORT_MAPPING
fields.label: A3: Bridge Port Mapping
fields.help: Automatically generated for bridge or an existing Docker network and removed in Host Mode.

fields.name: NAVIDROME_CONTAINER_NAME
fields.label: Container Name
fields.help: EasyDocker sets the container name from the project name.

fields.name: NAVIDROME_INTERNAL_PORT
fields.label: Internal Web Port
fields.help: Recipe-managed Navidrome port inside the container.

ui.overview: Navidrome scans your existing music collection and makes it available through a browser and Subsonic-compatible mobile or desktop clients.
what_happens: One Navidrome container will be created using the official image
Navidrome's database, cache, and application state will be stored in the writable data folder
Your existing music library will be mounted read-only so Navidrome cannot alter the original files
No runtime UID or GID is forced by default, preventing ownership failures with automatically created folders
Advanced users can optionally set a runtime UID:GID after preparing matching NAS folder permissions
Bridge networking is selected by default, with Host Mode and existing Docker networks also available
On first access, Navidrome will guide you through creation of its administrator account
Large music libraries can take time to complete their initial scan
ui.data_location: The data folder can be relative to this app's config folder or an absolute host path. The music folder should be the absolute path to your existing library and is mounted read-only. If you set the advanced runtime UID:GID, ensure it has write access to data and read access to music.
